cast.title: Opal Dream
cast.overview: Pobby & Dingan are invisible. They live in an opal town in Australia and are friends with Kellyanne, the 9 year-old daughter of an opal miner. The film tells the story of the bizarre and inexplicable disappearance of Pobby & Dingan, Kellyanne's imaginary friends, and the impact this has on her family and the whole town. The story is told through the eyes of Kellyanne's 11 years old brother Ashmol.

cast.title: Hey Hey It's Esther Blueburger
cast.overview: With help from a new friend, a misfit at a fancy private school secretly enrolls at a public school as a foreign exchange student.

cast.title: Panic at Rock Island
cast.overview: An island in spectacular Sydney Harbour. Summer sun,  top international artists, and tens of thousands of music fans from across the world!  Idyllic...until unimaginable disaster strikes.

cast.title: The Tree
cast.overview: The O'Neills lived happily in their house in the Australian countryside. That was until one day fate struck blindly, taking the life of Peter, the father, leaving his grief-stricken wife Dawn alone with their four children. Among them, eight-year-old Simone denies this reality. She is persuaded that her father still lives in the giant fig tree growing near their house and speaks to her through its leaves. But the tree becomes more and more invasive and threatens the house. It must be felled. Of course, Simone won't allow it.

cast.title: Purple Flowers
cast.overview: Jack likes Jill. Jill likes Jack. Two teenagers dealing with love, lust and death. A short film written and directed by Julian Ryan, stars Christian Byers and Airlie Dodds in the two main roles

cast.title: Purple Flowers

cast.title: December Boys
cast.overview: For many years, four teenage orphans at an Australian outback convent have watched their younger comrades find new parents, and realize that they may never be adopted. The Reverend Mother sends the four boys away on a seaside vacation, where they meet Teresa and Fearless, a couple who would make perfect parents. The youths compete with one another to be the one Teresa and Fearless decide to adopt.

cast.title: Dance Academy: The Movie
cast.overview: This 2017 movie follows the original dance academy TV show and tracks where the characters are in their lives now.

cast.title: Kettle
cast.overview: A teenage boy struggles to find acceptance and love within the confines of the repressive catholic school he attends and from his mother who is emotionally cold and completely lacks any understanding or compassion for her son. He reaches out to his estranged sister and even his best friend hoping to find the love and acceptance he so desperately needs which eventually leads him to a harrowing outcome.

cast.title: Laura
cast.overview: Two estranged friends stumble upon each other and reconnect over a shared loss.

cast.title: Riot
cast.overview: A look at the 1970s Gay Rights Movement in Australia through the eyes of dedicated activist Lance Gowland. As Lance deals with his sexuality, he must also juggle work, family and relationships.

cast.title: Death of an Undertaker
cast.overview: Shot over eight years, this hybrid documentary is set in a real-life funeral home on Leichhardt’s famous Norton St, and features an admirably game cast of actual morticians— Sparrow, a part-time worker whose fragile psyche begins to fracture in the lead-up to his first exhumation. On the brink of homelessness, Sparrow is offered shelter in the flat next door to the parlour, as the boundary between life and death – and work and self – dissolves into oblivion. Bleakly funny and formally playful.

cast.title: White Lines
cast.overview: When Amber discovers she is pregnant, she hides the news from her fellow drug dealing boyfriend Jacob, who spends his night snorting coke. After a chaotic night at a rave, Ambers future is left fractured and uncertain.

cast.title: Housewarming
cast.overview: Two directionless roommates life of leisure is threatened by the imminent sale of their rent controlled terrace. With six months till eviction they decide to enter the property market via the most lucrative and least competitive industries there is… podcasting.

cast.title: Bump: A Christmas Film
cast.overview: Set between episodes 9 and 10 of the final series, the film finds the family taking their festive spirit far from home and onto a South American cruise to Colombia. Despite best intentions, their plans quickly unravel in a series of chaotic events.

cast.title: The Moogai
cast.overview: A young Aboriginal couple brings home their second baby. What should be a joyous time takes a sinister turn, as the baby's mother starts seeing a malevolent spirit she is convinced is trying to take her baby.
